title: What Ahmed Can Do
gist_ar: أحمد بيقول بيقدر يعمل إيه ومبيقدرش، وبيحب إيه.

before_listening.en: Ahmed talks about himself. Listen for the one thing he CANNOT do.
before_listening.ar: أحمد بيتكلم عن نفسه. ركّز على الحاجة اللي مبيقدرش يعملها.

segments.speaker: Ahmed
segments.text: Hello, I am Ahmed. I can swim and I can drive a car. I can't cook. My food is not good! I like playing football with my friends on Friday. I love watching films at home. I don't like running. My brother can play the guitar, but I can't. He likes singing. I want to learn. Can you play music? Tell me!

options: What he can and cannot do, and what he likes

questions.q: What does he do on Friday?
options: He plays football with his friends
